usedFor: Shopify holds orders, and viaSocket utilities runs another workflow with “Flow in Flow” after “Order Cancelled”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order can start a separate clean-up workflow, kept apart from the one that caught it.

watchOut: “Flow in Flow” requires the child flow ID and a payload method, so set both before you run it.
